summary: Tanky troll who runs around with Poison Trail, flings you into his team, and proxy-farms behind your tower. The golden rule: never chase Singed. Ranged poke and %HP damage beat him; melee champions who chase him lose.
threats: Q (Poison Trail) leaves poison behind him, so chasing him means running through it.
E (Fling) throws you behind him; combined with W (Mega Adhesive), you get rooted in the goo.
Passive (Noxious Slipstream) speeds him up when he passes near champions.
R (Insanity Potion) at 5 gives him a huge stat boost for fights and roams.

matchups.why: Jayce pokes Singed out of lane with gated Shock Blast and never needs to chase him. Singed has no way to reach Jayce from range, and Hammer E knocks him away if he runs in.
trading: Gated Cannon Q whenever he walks up to farm.
Hammer E him away when he runs in for Fling.
Never chase him through his Poison Trail.
Stand away from walls so his Fling can't pin you.
matchups.early: Poke from range at levels 1–3; he can't trade back or reach you without Fling.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R gives him a big stat boost. Keep distance and poke rather than all-in.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates; don't let him proxy farm behind your tower.
matchups.jungle: He escapes by running. Gank only when he's past mid-lane.
matchups.build: Electrocute or Phase Rush. Lethality items.

matchups.why: Vayne's W (Silver Bolts) true damage shreds Singed's tankiness, and she can kite him without chasing through poison. Condemn knocks him away when he runs in for Fling.
trading: Auto him whenever he walks up; he can't reach you without Fling.
Condemn him away when he runs in for Fling.
Never chase him through his Poison Trail; let him come to you.
Tumble (Q) away from his W goo before he can Fling you into it.
matchups.early: Kite and farm. He can't kill you without his jungler, so poke him off the wave.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R gives him a big stat boost; keep distance and don't fight inside his goo.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates; don't let him proxy farm.
matchups.jungle: He escapes by running. Gank only when he's past mid-lane.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. Crit and on-hit; %HP items.

matchups.why: Darius can pull Singed out of his poison and bleed him down, but Singed's Fling and run-away playstyle make Darius chase, and chasing Singed is how Darius loses. The lane comes down to whether Darius lands E without chasing.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him when he walks up to Fling you.
Never chase him through his Poison Trail.
Stack Hemorrhage while he's stuck in melee range.
Stand away from walls so his Fling can't pin you.
matchups.early: Even. Farm and pull him when he walks up to Fling you; don't chase.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R makes him faster and tankier; your R resets on kill.
matchups.wave: Freeze near your tower so he has to walk up to farm.
matchups.jungle: He escapes by running. Gank only when he's past mid-lane.
matchups.build: Conqueror. MR boots against his poison.

matchups.why: Tank vs tank: Malphite's Q poke chips Singed, but Singed's poison damage is magic, so Malphite's armor doesn't help. Neither can kill the other alone, so the lane is decided by roams.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) him when he walks up to farm.
Never chase him through his Poison Trail.
E (Ground Slam) when he's in melee range.
Stand away from walls so his Fling can't pin you.
matchups.early: Farm and Q poke. Neither of you can kill the other alone, so don't waste HP.
matchups.spike: At 5 both of you can roam; ward river and track where his R goes.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and roam once your R is up; don't let him proxy farm.
matchups.jungle: Your R sets up ganks. Call when he's past mid-lane.
matchups.build: Aftershock. MR boots against his poison.
